scientific_integrity: Self-contained parameter-specific proof with an exact-rational computational check; all general inherited results and unsupported generalizations are delimited.
scientific_limitations: Exact geometric TV formula is for Lebesgue initial data and step-density subspace, not a general BV spectral gap. Transient prefactor may vanish. The metric-entropy equality locus specializes prior Parry/maximum-ACIM theory; it is not asserted as a new general theorem. Historical priority provisional, no independent validation.
title: Fixed symbolic entropy with tunable exact physical relaxation in a five-branch interval family
